attributes.action: Police shouldn’t be allowed to ram motorbikes due to safety concerns
attributes.additional_details: Riders may chose to break the laws and rules of the road but they don’t chose to be killed by an officer using tactical contact on a vehicle that has no safety measures to protect the rider in the event of a crash. What gives an officer the power to end a persons life intentional or not they should not be allowed to make contact with any sort of motorbike quad bike or e-bike at any speed due to the safety of the rider in doing so the are disregarding all safety for the rider and their life
attributes.background: The government should not allow police to ram motorbikes and ebikes or quad bikes due to safety for the rider they need to pass a law to protect riders from the police there are other means to catching them that doesn’t risk the riders life

rejection.details:
Decisions on when to use tactical contact is an operational matter for individual Chief Officers, and in practice necessarily of enforcement/police officers on duty, not the Government or Parliament.

A police officer could already under law be committing an offence were he to use excessive force in contacting a vehicle unnecessarily, leading to the harm of death of the rider.
